evidence.note: JETTS is a benchmark evaluating how well LLM-as-judge models perform as evaluators guiding test-time-scaling methods -- response reranking, step-level beam search, and critique-based refinement -- across math, code and instruction-following.
evidence.title: Evaluating Judges as Evaluators: The JETTS Benchmark of LLM-as-Judges as Test-Time Scaling Evaluators
